jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) Institute for Cardiogenetics 1 (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Das Universitätsklinikum Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) verbindet internationale Spitzenforschung mit interdisziplinärer Krankenversorgung. Wir sind einziger Maximalversorger und größter Arbeitgeber des Landes. Unsere rund 17.500 Mitarbeitenden stellen eine höchst individuelle Versorgung sicher - unverzichtbar für die Menschen in Schleswig-Holstein.Institute of CardiogeneticsThe position is based at the Institute of Cardiogenetics at the UKSH. The institute brings together experts in life science, bioinformatics, and cardiovascular medicine to advance the understanding of molecular mechanisms underlying heart disease and to translate these insights into preclinical approaches. The work will be carried out within the framework of the Precision Medicine in Chronic Inflammation (PMI) https://www.precisionmedicine.de/de/ueber-den-cluster, and in close collaboration with the Clinic of Dermatology at the USKH Campus Lübeck.Start in our teamWe are looking for a highly motivated person to join our dynamic interdisciplinary team. You will contribute to ambitious, collaborative projects focused primarily on inflammatory disease research. Join our team and support us from January 1st, 2027, initially limites for three years as Postdoctoral Researcher.What do we offer:- Salary payment in accordance to remuneration group E13 TV-L, based on a fixed-term contract for 3 years- Full-time employment, currently 38.5 hours/ week. Part-time employment may be compatible within the framework of certain working time models- Stimulating environment and interdisciplinary research team- Participation in the "PMI Cluster of Excellence - DFG EXC 2167/2" and the German Center of Cardiovascular Research (DZHK)- Discover more exciting employee benefits at UKSH here: Benefits (uksh.de)Your responsibilities:- Apply methods from molecular epidemiology to WGS and scRNA Seq data- In silico annotations of genomics findings- Perform statistical data analysis, data integration, and visualization and contribute to the publication of research findings and research grant applications- Provide support to interdisciplinary team members- Close involvement in the PMI Project "Sex Diversity in CID"Your profile:- A strong background in bioinformatics, computational biology, data sciences, or a related field, with knowledge of biology, and a PhD (or a minimum of 3 yrs experience in the field) is required- Statistical and bioinformatic skills, in particular analysis of human, in vitro, and in vivo omics datasets combined with hands-on experience in experimental validation of genetic and molecular findings- Experience in applying statistical methods from genetic epidemiology- Expertise in Linux/Unix environment, HPC clusters, proficiency in R, Python, and practical knowledge of reproducible workflow systems (e.g. Nextflow, Snakemake) and version control tools is appreciated- Strong communication skills, with a passion for interdisciplinary teamwork, as well as fluency in English; knowledge of German is an advantageWe look forward to receiving your application by 25 November 2026. Please quote the job reference number 29442 in your application.

jobs.occupation: Executive Manager (m/f/d) International Procurement Indirects (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.description: Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. With pizza, cake, and desserts, as well as digital platforms and services - quality and an innovative spirit set us apart.What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?JOIN THE TASTE.YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES- You assume overall responsibility for the strategic direction, development and performance of international strategic and tactical procurement for indirect goods and services. As a member of the international procurement leadership team, you ensure the implementation of defined standards, value contributions and the overarching procurement strategy.- Your responsibilities include leading and developing the International Procurement Indirects organization. Together with international Commodity Managers and the wider Indirects team you establish high-performing collaboration, successful execution of impactful category strategies, clear accountabilities and a leadership culture aligned with Dr. Oetker's leadership principles.- You continuously advance the International Indirects agenda and deliver sustainable value through strategic demand management, standardization, bundling, digitalization and a forward-looking approach to supplier portfolio management.- Furthermore, you manage the performance of the assigned categories, create transparency regarding target achievement and value contribution and establish effective global standards, processes and governance mechanisms.- You lead strategic and complex international negotiations and ensure professional supplier relationship management, proactive risk management and effective escalation mechanisms.- In addition, you actively contribute to the further development of the International Procurement Indirects organization and its target operating model. In doing so, you establish clear roles, decision-making pathways, governance structures and harmonized ways of working.- You build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders on an international level.- As a strategic business partner, you advise international functions and senior management on investments, make-or-buy decisions, innovation initiatives and business-critical transformation programs.- You initiate and lead international and cross-functional projects, represent the procurement perspective in due diligence processes within M&A activities and act as the representative of International Procurement Indirects in relevant steering committees.WHAT YOU BRING- You hold a university degree and are a true procurement expert. You bring many years of international experience and deep expertise in strategic indirect procurement of goods and services and/or commodity management across key and complex indirect spend categories.- Ideally, you have a proven track record in leading and developing international teams and are experienced in managing complex matrix organizations. Even without direct disciplinary authority you are able to inspire and mobilize people to achieve shared objectives effectively.- You have a strong command of managing complex transformation and change initiatives within international organizations. You combine strategic foresight with strong business acumen and a results-oriented execution mindset.- You excel in stakeholder-focused communication at management and executive level, possess outstanding stakeholder management skills and handle conflicting priorities, complex negotiations and escalations with confidence.- You think strategically, analytically and solution-oriented, take ownership and constructively challenge existing processes and ways of working. Strong intercultural competence and a collaborative leadership style further distinguish you.- You have a solid understanding of digital procurement solutions, integrated Source-to-Contract and Procure-to-Pay processes as well as data-driven performance management models. Knowledge of SAP MM and BW, along with proficiency in Microsoft 365, would be an advantage.- You recognize the potential of Artificial Intelligence and data-driven solutions and leverage them purposefully to advance procurement, improve decision quality and enhance value creation.- Fluency in German and English, as well as a willingness to travel internationally, round off your profile.WHAT WE OFFER YOU- Attractive remuneration- Flexible work models & mobile work- 30 days of vacation plus Special vacation at Christmas & New Year's Eve- Onboarding and professional development opportunities- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop- Events and celebrations- Sports, health and fitness offers- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

jobs.occupation: People Strategist International IT (m/f/d) (Wirtschaftspsychologe/-psychologin)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionOur Transformation JourneyAs METRO.digital evolves, we are reshaping the way we work through our Target Operating Model (TOM).TOM describes the desired state of our organization’s operational capabilities and functions. It provides a vision for the future state of the business, explaining how the company needs to operate to deliver its strategy and achieve its business goals efficiently. The TOM outlines how various elements like processes, technology, governance, and people should interconnect and interact to deliver value. It serves as a roadmap for implementing organizational change and transformation.About the TeamWe think globally and act locally. Since October 1, our international IT organization has been operating under the new Target Operating Model (TOM). This international IT organization, spanning 21 countries and multiple companies, is the dedicated scope of the International People Strategist. As part of our international People & Culture team, you will establish and embed end-to-end people processes for this IT organization, build trusted relationships with its leaders and local P&C teams, and develop an effective cross-country network. You will connect global frameworks with the specific requirements of the international IT organization and its country organizations, contributing across the full spectrum of People & Culture work, from hands-on operational implementation to strategic initiatives.Beyond day-to-day tasks, our work creates stability, builds trust, and strengthens our culture, enabling our people to thrive and our business to grow.How you will make an impact?As People Strategist for International IT, you are the dedicated P&C Business Partner for our international IT organization, across all METRO countries and companies. Your scope covers the leaders, employees, and organizational units within this international IT organization. You play a key role in embedding the new Target Operating Model by establishing and continuously improving People & Culture processes throughout the employee lifecycle, building trusted relationships, and developing an effective network across the IT organization, its countries, companies, and functions. The role combines hands-on operational work, process ownership, cross-functional coordination, and strategic People & Culture contributions for the international IT organization. Working closely with its leaders, local P&C teams, and Corporate expert functions such as Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, and Learning, you translate global approaches into practical, consistent, and locally compliant solutions for the IT organization.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Establish and embed the People & Culture processes, relationships, networks, and ways of working required to make the new Target Operating Model effective within the international IT organization;- Design, establish, implement, and continuously improve People & Culture processes across the entire employee lifecycle for the international IT organization, ensuring clear ownership and effective execution;- Provide hands-on operational support as well as conceptual and strategic People & Culture contributions to the leaders, employees, and organizational units within the international IT organization, depending on business and organizational needs;- Partner with P&C country functions to translate international frameworks into practical solutions for the international IT organization that reflect local business needs, legal requirements, and organizational maturity;- Coordinate closely with Corporate People & Culture expert functions, including Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, Learning, and other relevant teams, to deliver integrated solutions for the international IT organization;- Support leaders within the international IT organization and their local P&C teams on organizational design, workforce planning, talent, performance, succession, engagement, and employee relations, while enabling appropriate local ownership;- Drive the consistent implementation of global People & Culture frameworks across the international IT organization and facilitate alignment among its countries, companies, functions, and matrix structures;- Use people data, KPIs, and business insights from the international IT organization to identify trends, monitor process effectiveness, assess risks, and derive actionable improvements;- Support organizational change and culture initiatives within the international IT organization and contribute to a consistent employee and manager experience across its countries and companies;- Ensure that People & Culture solutions for the international IT organization comply with applicable labor laws, co-determination requirements, internal policies, and governance standards, in collaboration with the relevant local and Corporate stakeholders.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Law, or a related field;- At least 5 years of relevant HR experience, including several years as an HR Business Partner in an international or matrix organization;- Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders and translating business priorities into pragmatic people solutions;- Strong knowledge of German labor law and employee relations; experience working across additional jurisdictions is an advantage;- Proven capability in organizational design, workforce planning, talent and performance management, and change management;- Confidence working with people data, KPIs, and HRIS/HCM systems to support evidence-based decisions;- Strong business acumen, stakeholder management, consulting, and coaching skills, with the ability to influence across cultures and organizational boundaries;- Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex change;- Very good fluency in English (written and verbal), German preferred;- Additional languages are an advantage;- Willingness to collaborate across time zones and travel internationally when required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: People Strategist 3 (Md7).

Then, please send us your application: SCHOTT AG, Human Resources, Emma Theresa Reich, +496131664854*At SCHOTT, it's your personality that counts - not your gender, your identity, or origin.- Talent developmentTrust-based working timeMultiple career opportunitiesExclusive employee benefits/discounts

jobs.occupation: wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in (w/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik ist am Institut für Informatik – Empirische Softwaretechnik – zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d)(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung eines Promotionsverfahrens oder einer Weiterqualifizierung in der Postdoc-Phase im Bereich Empirische Softwaretechnik dient. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für einen Zeitraum von i. d. R. 3 Jahren, zu besetzen. Eine Verlängerung ist innerhalb der Befristungsgrenzen des WissZeitVG ggf. möglich.Gesucht wird ein*e Wissenschaftler*in, die*der einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten möchte, digitale Systeme sicher und privatsphärenfreundlich zu gestalten und dabei Nutzer*innen der digitalen Systeme zu zentrieren. Voraussetzungen sind Interesse an empirischen Methoden, die den Faktor Mensch miteinbeziehen.Aufgabenbereich:• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS sowie Mitarbeit in Forschung im Bereich Empirische Softwaretechnik• Ggf. Mitarbeit an drittmittelfinanzierten Forschungsprojekten des FachgebietsEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master oder vergleichbar)• Promotion (bei Postdocs)• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Schrift und Wort; Befähigung zu Forschung und Lehre in deutscher Sprache wünschenswert• Erfahrungen (demonstriert durch Masterarbeit und/oder vorherige Berufserfahrungen) in mindestens einem der Bereiche IT-Sicherheit, Empirische Softwaretechnik, Sichere Softwareentwicklung, Human Computer Interaction, Cyberphysical SystemsWir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7417, vorzugsweise in einer PDF-Datei, erbeten an: applications-es@lists.uni-paderborn.de.Paderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!In the Faculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematics at the Department of Computer Science – Empirical Software Engineering – the following position is to be filled as soon as possible as aResearch Assistant (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100 % of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which either serves to support a PhD procedure or the scientific qualification in the post-doctoral phase in the field of Empirical Software Engineering. The position is, depending on the qualification achieved to date, initially limited for a period of three years. An extension is generally possible within the time limits of the “WissZeitVG”.We are looking for a researcher who is willing to make an important contribution by making digital systems secure and privacy-friendly while centering users of digital systems. Prerequisites are an interest in empirical methods that include the human factor.Field of activity:• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week and participation in research in the field of Empirical Software Engineering• Collaboration in externally funded research projects of the research group, if applicableRecruitment requirements:• Scientific university degree (Master or equivalent)• Ph.D. (as Postdoc)• Very good written and spoken English; ability to teach and conduct research in German desirable• Experience (demonstrated via master's thesis and/or previous professional experience) in at least one of the areas of IT security, empirical software engineering, secure software development, human computer interaction, cyberphysical systemsWe offer:• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents, preferably in a single PDF-file, using the Ref. No. 7417 to: applications-es@lists.uni-paderborn.de.

These include, but are not limited to, medical gymnastics, manual lymphatic drainage, sling table therapy, heat and cold therapy, wellness treatments, home visits as well as group therapies and training in your own gym. In addition, osteopathy will also be offered from November 2025.The practice places great emphasis on personal care, modern treatment methods and a holistic approach to therapy. The aim is to sustainably treat discomfort, improve mobility and promote long-term health.Due to high patient demand, we are now seeking support for our team in Atteln and Lichtenauas Physiotherapist (m/w/d) full-time or part-time!You are the right fit for our team if you:- Want to bring your acquired knowledge to bear with fun- Completed vocational training as a physiotherapist- Have empathy, flexibility, reliability and teamwork skills- Commitment, customer orientation and loyalty characterize your persona- You show a willingness to develop professionally- You have a structured way of working and an openness to new thingsSupport us in the following tasks: - Treatment of individual patients, mainly in the field of orthopaedics and neurology- In manual therapy, manual lymphatic drainage, medical gymnastics, classical massages, bobath, mud as well as cold therapies, machine treatments (own fitness studio in Lichtenau)- Treatment documentation and reportsWe offer: - An open and appreciative working climate in a motivated team- Flexible working hours based on our practice hours- Attractive remuneration ( 3400€ - 3800€ depending on qualification) and promotion of private pension insurance- An open-ended contract from day one- Minor administrative work (office back-up)- Modern, friendly and spacious treatment rooms- Provision of workwear in the form of T-shirts and sweatshirts- Support for training costs up to 1000 € per year- Team EventsInformation for applicants from abroad:- Language skills German ideally from A2- Interviews via Skype or telephone, communication in English is alternatively possible- Applications in English or German desired- Support with administrative procedures- Help in finding accommodation or providing a first housing option- A personal coach who will assist you with the training- Working and living in a small town with a wide range of leisure activities- Supporting your family in integrating at their place of work/residenceZIP code 33165 belongs to the city of Lichtenau (Westphalia) in the district of Paderborn in the state of North Rhine-Westphalia. The town consists of 15 districts, including Atteln, Asseln, Dalheim, Herbram, Holtheim, Husen and Kleinenberg. The total population is 10,500–11,000 and covers an area of about 192 km2.Location and region Lichtenau is located about 15–20 kilometres southeast of Paderborn on the edge of the Egge Mountains. The region is characterised by its proximity to nature, many small villages and a relatively low population density.Transport Good access to the Paderborn region and the A44 (Dortmund-Kassel). Bus services connect the districts with Paderborn, Büren and the neighbouring municipalities. Paderborn/Lippstadt Airport can be reached in about 20–30 minutes.Supply Supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies and primary health care are mainly located in the core town of Lichtenau.Kindergartens, primary and secondary schools are available in the city. Particularly attractive are the hiking and cycling trails, the active club life and the proximity to Paderborn while at the same time being in a quiet residential locationIf you are reliable and like to work independently, I look forward to receiving your application by e-mail.For applicants who have their permanent residence abroad: The International and Specialized Services will help you find a job in Germany. We are a department of the German Federal Employment Agency. Our service is free of charge. We will be happy to inform you:+49 (0) 228 713 1313 / zav@arbeitsagentur.deIncomingZAV****************************************************************************************************************************************Die PPL – Physiotherapie und Präventionszentrum Lichtenau ist eine moderne Physiotherapiepraxis mit Standorten in Lichtenau und Atteln. Das Unternehmen bietet ein breites Angebot an physiotherapeutischen und präventiven Leistungen für Menschen jeden Alters. jobs.occupation: Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) Generators (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG.
jobs.description: This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. The role addresses the need for focused commercial management due to an expanding product portfolio, including electric motors and maritime applications, and increasing complexity in external projects with international clients. To meet these business objectives, the role is structured around three core areas: comprehensive Commercial Offer and Bid Management for all projects, rigorous Sales Process and Financial Governance using tools like Salesforce and PATAC, and proactive Stakeholder and Risk Management to navigate complex international requirements and ensure seamless collaboration between technical and commercial teams. Given the focus on these areas, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in commercial sales and contract management within an industrial manufacturing context. A proven ability to manage complex international projects, including financial calculations and risk mitigation, is essential for success in this role.How You’ll Make an Impact- Lead the development and preparation of commercial offers for all internal and external generator, electric motor, and maritime application projects originating from the Erfurt factory.- Structure, draft, and negotiate complex sales contracts, amendments, and bid documents in collaboration with technical sales, legal, and business management teams.- Manage the end-to-end bid and proposal process, ensuring all submissions are competitive, compliant, and aligned with strategic business objectives.- Develop and implement pricing strategies and perform detailed cost calculations for all tenders and proposals.- Manage all commercial sales activities and pipeline information within Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and generating regular sales reports.- Execute and oversee core commercial processes, including the Project Approval and Tender Approval Committee (PATAC) workflow, bond applications, and financial clearances.- Ensure the fulfillment of contractual financial obligations, coordinating with finance on topics such as invoicing and payment terms.- Continuously improve commercial sales processes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risks.- Serve as the primary commercial liaison for key external clients, managing complex requirements related to international tax issues, permanent establishment (PE) setup, and local installation services.- Collaborate closely with the technical sales team to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and to prevent execution problems on complex projects.- Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, financial, and contractual risks throughout the entire sales cycle.- Coach and delegate work to lower-level professionals, acting as a subject matter expert for commercial sales processes.What You Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.- Several years of experience in a senior commercial sales, contract management, or bid management role, preferably within the power generation or heavy industrial equipment sector.- Demonstrated experience managing large, complex international projects and navigating associated tax, legal, and logistical challenges.- Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and financial calculation tools is required.- German and English fluency.Rewards/Benefits- In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme- We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder- We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity- The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose- In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Functional Safety Complex Systems, ADAS, AD (f/m/d) / 21762 (ADAS/AD Engineer)
jobs.description: Im Geschäftsbereich Mobilität suchen wir engagierte Talente, die den Weg für eine sichere, nachhaltige und smarte Mobilität von morgen ebnen möchten und damit Wegbereiter einer besseren Mobilität werden. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung der Verkehrssicherheit und Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für alle Verkehrssysteme und -träger – von der Straße über die Schiene bis zur Luft. Mit unserer Expertise sorgen wir für mehr Sicherheit und Effizienz im Verkehr durch ganzheitliche Ansätze und fortschrittliche Konzepte.Activities und responsibilities- Plan, coordinate and conduct Functional Safety audits, assessments and technical reviews, including the evaluation of ISO 26262 work products from item definition and HARA through safety concepts, verification, validation and safety case documentation.- Create audit plans, assessment concepts, reports, findings, recommendations and certification-relevant documentation.- Review SOTIF work products and assess evidence for complex data-driven systems, covering functional insufficiencies, triggering conditions, ODD, intended use, foreseeable misuse, data representativeness, scenario coverage, monitoring, fallback and residual-risk arguments.- Develop assessment and evidence concepts for AI-driven systems where deterministic assurance is insufficient; support Type Approval and homologation by translating Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI and regulatory requirements—e.g., UN R171/DCAS—into practical guidance.- Deliver consultancy and support business acquisition through customer workshops, pre-sales, technical interviews, bid support, gap analyses, document reviews, pre-assessments and project reviews; contribute to service development for automated driving and AI-enabled vehicle systems.- Coordinate international projects and harmonise technical delivery across regions and business units globally; connect Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI, cybersecurity, testing, certification and Type Approval at subject and team level while strengthening internal capabilities through guidance, training and knowledge sharing.Experience und further qualifications- Senior automotive safety expert with hands-on experience in safety-critical E/E systems, embedded software, ADAS/AD, simulation-based verification, validation and testing, complemented by a background in software development, systems engineering, architecture and technical project delivery- Extensive Functional Safety expertise under ISO 26262/8800, including safety lifecycle, HARA, ASIL, ASPICE, safety concepts, safety analyses and safety case documentation; experienced with FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, DFA, STPA and comparable methods- Sound knowledge of SOTIF according to ISO 21448 and its interaction with Functional Safety for perception-based and data-driven functions; familiarity with Type Approval, homologation, software update management and automotive cybersecurity is beneficial- Strong understanding of automotive AI and machine-learning applications, including perception, sensor fusion, prediction, planning, decision-making, monitoring and fallback; able to assess systems with limited explainability and incomplete scenario coverage- Broad knowledge of automotive development processes, including requirements engineering, configuration and change management, validation planning, tool qualification and evidence management; experienced in audits, assessments, confirmation reviews and independent technical evaluations- Consulting, pre-sales, business acquisition and bid-process experience, combined with strong analytical judgement, a structured auditor mindset, customer orientation and excellent communication skills; fluent in German and English, with willingness to travel internationally.
